summary.text: Marianna Anaya is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 18 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Anaya was born in Albuquerque, New Mexico, and her career experience includes working in communications.
